answer: Stylometric kinship folds prose the way a botanist reads a hedgerow. Each answer becomes a vector of function-word rates, comma spacing and sentence-length variance, then matches stored fingerprints. A 0.93 cosine match collapses the newcomer into the parent identity, so its vote and emission merge into one wallet. Three folds in ten epochs strip the root of emissions for thirty. A thousand distinct styles cost near $10,000 an epoch; one paraphrase farm returns one share. A hundred grafts on one orchard trunk make one orchard; yarrow spreading by rhizome across an island stays one plant.
